steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Order. Each queue's depth is placed through the day.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 queue is above its depth limit

findings.title: Depth rising for three intervals in a row
findings.fix: Find the cause before the limit

findings.title: Item older than its service level

outcome.notChecked: Work not in the queue; the quality of the work.

pros: Checks a queue above its depth limit, an item older than its service level, and a depth rising for three intervals in a row.

input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-ops-queue-monitor skill on the records for this review.
